name: Bug Diagnosis
description: Reproduce, isolate, fix, and verify a software failure without speculative edits.
approval_boundaries: Do not fix before the failure is reproduced or evidence explains why reproduction is unavailable.
Escalate when expected behavior is contradictory.

phases.name: Failure triage
phases.instructions: Identify the first actionable failure and separate secondary noise.

phases.name: Diagnosis
phases.instructions: Reproduce, narrow, and test causal hypotheses.

phases.name: Source check
phases.instructions: Confirm the fix against authoritative behavior.

phases.name: Regression fix
phases.instructions: Add a focused regression test and make the smallest fix.

phases.name: Fix handoff
phases.instructions: Report cause, changes, validation, risk, and next action.
